Appraiser remarks
The vehicle presents front-quarter damage on the driver side, consistent with a
collision during a left-hand turn. The bumper cover is cracked and displaced, the
headlamp assembly is broken, and the fender shows crush deformation with paint
transfer along the seam. The crush pattern and the location of the contact points line
up with the account given for how the impact occurred. Nothing on the car suggests
older damage, and no prior repairs are recorded in its file. The proposed plan replaces
the bumper cover, headlamp, and fender, followed by refinishing and a wheel alignment
check. The labor hours listed are in line with the work described, and the invoices
submitted show each charge once with no duplicates.
